column1: # The login each actor uses in a journey run. These are the Privy test logins from the README:
# fixed codes, no real phone or inbox, safe to keep in git. A run holds a lock on each login it uses, and a
# journey's actor can run on another free login (slot 1 takes what slot 0 leaves, see docs/journeys/README.md). scripts/qa/journey.py passes a row
# to a test as MONACO_QA_<actor>_PHONE, _EMAIL, _CODE and _NAME. Export those to use another login.
